'''Saijo''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] near [[Cantros 7]]. It had green river valleys.

==History==
It was part of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]]<ref name="SW93" /> until [[Raid on Saijo|conquered]] by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during the [[Nagai–Tof War]]. It was later [[Conquest of Saijo|taken]] by the [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]] and eventually became the location of the last [[Battle of Saijo|battle]] of the conflict.<ref name="TFW" />

[[File:Saijo-MC107.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Saijo landscape after the Tof conquest.]]

By [[130 ABY]], the world was a colony and fortress world of the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]]. When the galaxy was reclaimed by the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]] of [[Darth Krayt]], Saijo was claimed as well, and the planet became one of the most heavily-defended worlds in the Outer Rim.<ref name="LECG" />
